title: select_channel off-by-one: returns [1,n] but valid is [0,n-1]
description:
File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:89

select_channel returns 1-based indices but frequency() expects 0-based; 1/n of channel selections are out of bounds.

**Failure scenario:** With eui64=0x0011223344556677, epoch=2, density=0, plan=EU868: select_channel returns 8 but valid indices are 0-7. Calling frequency(8) raises ValueError. Affects 12.5% of epochs for EU868.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
close_reason: dup of gvgi root cause: contract mismatch not formula bug; channel_number mapping added per spec ccp12; see gvgi close note
